# Pass 2 while another restic, in a job of hostname pc-k3j9x2m4q8w1z7v, held
# an exclusive lock (a check --read-data): restic's four lines, exit code 11.
# Then the same while restic on host nas held a shared lock (a backup), with
# --retry-lock 6s: "repo already locked, waiting up to 6s for the lock" on the
# standard output, the four lines once the wait is over. The lock's "(… ago)" is
# when its holder last refreshed it. Last, pass 1 while the exclusive lock was
# held: it takes no lock, and passes.
